requirements.purpose: Establish persistent urban heat as the environmental condition.
requirements.truth_boundary: Contextual Dhaka heat; no invented extreme event presented as documentary fact.
requirements.visual_type: contextual editorial still or sourced city heat imagery

requirements.truth_boundary: Prefer explanatory map/heat graphic or contextual city image; do not imply precise block-level temperature without data.

requirements.purpose: Humanize physical work strain without fabricating an identified victim.
requirements.truth_boundary: Generic/contextual worker scene may represent evidenced conditions; must not imply depicted person is a study participant.

requirements.purpose: Show indoor factory heat and ventilation/cooling context.
requirements.truth_boundary: Do not depict a named factory unless sourced media supports it.

requirements.purpose: Show the time-versus-income dilemma for outdoor work.
requirements.truth_boundary: Contextual Dhaka informal work, not a claimed individual case.

requirements.purpose: Income consequence is better carried by text/data than invented money imagery.
requirements.truth_boundary: Use deterministic data treatment if visualized.

requirements.purpose: Scale household losses into national workday/economic burden.
requirements.truth_boundary: Clearly label estimates and source period.

requirements.purpose: Show that exposure continues into domestic recovery space.
requirements.truth_boundary: Contextual home scene only; no invented named household or false documentary specificity.

requirements.purpose: Avoid over-specifying unresolved household coping behavior.
requirements.truth_boundary: No factual visual claim beyond supported unequal cooling/recovery capacity.
Prefer sourced/contextual school heat imagery; do not depict a specific closure as factual unless sourced.
Do not invent childcare/learning-loss scene as documentary evidence.
Distinguish examples/recommendations from installed systems at a named site.
Use sourced numbers in deterministic graphic; no guarantee framing.

requirements.purpose: Leave unresolved distribution question primarily to text/evidence.
requirements.truth_boundary: Do not symbolize poverty or suffering with unsupported imagery.
